text:
For statement, di 40-year-old British actor say: "To say dis role na dream come true na understatement".
Di video wey confam Robert Pattinson as James Bond show di English actor wit gun in hand, wearing tuxedo.
For statement, Pattinson say: "James Bond na one of di most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted wit 007 na di honour of lifetime.
"I dey deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and evrione for Amazon MGM Studios for dia belief in me.
"I no fit dey more excited about dis partnership and di work ahead wit dis fantastic team."
Robert Pattinson career don already dey fly high wit roles for feems wey include di Twilight series, The Batman and The Odyssey, so signing up to play James Bond go propel im profile into di stratosphere.
E dey already established imsef as a leading man, action star and character actor, wey clearly show why e go play di suave, British secret agent 007.
At 40, e dey slightly older dan some of di oda men reportedly lined up for di role, but e dey also di most famous - sometin di new Bond studio Amazon-MGM fit don favour, wit eye on di box office.
Im recent work don gada both critical and box office success, including Christopher Nolan summer blockbuster The Odyssey, in which e play di villainous Antinous.
Pattinson dey also called "Oscar-worthy" by di Independent and "superb" by The Times, for im performance for November Primetime, as di real-life host of US TV show To Catch a Predator.
E also help lead 2022 The Batman to di second-biggest North American opening of di Covid-19 pandemic behind Spider-Man: No Way Home. The Guardian say e play di "brooding" role wit "appealing vulnerability".
Born in Barnes, south-west London, Pattinson grow up wit im father, a classic car trader and mother, wey work for modelling agency, and two elder sisters.
Im interest for acting start while e bin still dey school, wen e join di Barnes Theatre Club.
"I no go dey act if it no be for dat little club," e tell Your Local Guardian for 2008.
"I go originally becos a lot of pretty girls dey go dia," e say. "I work backstage and I start act wen all di good pipo comot and I was di only one tall enough to play di lead.
E land im first big film role more dan two decades ago, playing Cedric Diggory in 2005 Harry Potter and thediGoblet of Fire. A relatively minor character, but e be no dey enough to get am noticed.
Three years later, e get starring role in di first of five Twilight films, along wit Kristen Stewart, in which dem play star-crossed lovers - vampire Edward Cullen and mortal-turned vampire Kristen Stewart.
